categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two segments: Printed Circuit Board (PCB) manufacturing and Electronic Manufacturing Service (EMS). PCB products serve various applications including personal computers, storage devices, network communication products, consumer electronics, and automotive electronics such as body control, advanced driver assistance systems, and new energy vehicle battery management. EMS services include mold making, injection molding, coating, SMT placement, and system assembly, focusing on substrate assembly for PCs, storage, communication, consumer electronics, automotive, power tools, smart home, industrial products, and LED.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including high-layer count and high-frequency products, HDI (High Density Interconnect) technology, asymmetric multi-layer lamination, 67GHz insertion loss measurement, and probe card development. Production processes cover multilayer PCB fabrication, laser drilling, plating, etching, and assembly with SMT and DIP components. The company invests in high-end equipment such as high-layer pin lamination machines, pulse plating lines, back-drilling machines, and automated signal measurement systems to support AI server and high-speed communication product demands.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in personal computing, network communication, consumer electronics, automotive electronics (including electric and autonomous vehicles), and industrial sectors. The company serves global AI server providers, PC and gaming device makers, and telecommunications equipment manufacturers. Major end markets are Asia, Americas, and Europe, with Asia accounting for over 94% of sales. The company also targets emerging markets in Southeast Asia and focuses on AI-related high-value PCB products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with a strong presence in Asia, which accounts for the majority of its revenue (over 94%). It has manufacturing facilities in Taiwan and China (Jiangyin), and is expanding operations in Southeast Asia to better serve regional customers. Sales are also made to the Americas and Europe, representing smaller portions of total revenue. The company leverages its global footprint to optimize supply chain and customer service.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the electronics supply chain. It manufactures PCBs and provides EMS services including assembly and testing, integrating vertically to offer comprehensive solutions from substrate fabrication to system assembly. It maintains strong upstream supplier relationships for raw materials like copper foil and chemicals, but its core business is in manufacturing and assembly rather than raw material extraction or end-product retail.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities focus on expanding AI server and AI PC product lines, increasing the proportion of high-layer count and HDI PCB products, and developing high-frequency and high-speed PCB technologies. R&D initiatives include asymmetric multi-layer lamination, high-density AI server products, stepped gold finger acceleration cards, 67GHz insertion loss measurement, ultra-high frequency switch materials, advanced probe cards, and PTFE radar products. The company also invests in production capacity expansion and equipment upgrades to meet future AI and communication market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of PCBs and EMS services. The company sells high-value, complex multilayer and HDI PCBs and provides electronic assembly services to various industries. It also generates income from real estate sales and investments in related companies. The revenue model is based on manufacturing contracts and sales orders from global electronics manufacturers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is ranked as the 16th largest professional PCB manufacturer globally (excluding PCBA) according to Prismark data. It competes in the high-end PCB market with a focus on AI server, HDI, and multilayer boards. Competitive advantages include leadership in notebook PC PCB segment, strong partnerships with ODMs, flexible manufacturing, vertical integration, cost efficiency, and advanced R&D capabilities. It faces competition from other global PCB manufacturers and EMS providers but differentiates through technology and service breadth.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported annual revenues of approximately NT$41.6 billion in 2024, with a slight decline from the previous year. Net profit attributable to owners increased by 12.4% to about NT$3 billion. Total assets grew by 14% to NT$89.4 billion, and equity increased by 6.6%. The company maintains strong cash flow and continues capital investments, with R&D expenses around NT$376 million in 2024. The growth trajectory is supported by AI-driven market demand and strategic capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-value, high-layer count, and high-frequency PCB products tailored for AI servers, communication, and automotive electronics. It differentiates through advanced manufacturing technologies, vertical integration, flexible production capabilities, and strong customer partnerships. Its commitment to quality, innovation, and sustainability, including ISO certifications and environmental management, enhances its competitive edge. The company also leverages global footprint and service capabilities to meet diverse customer needs efficiently.
